season: Game 1.4.002 with the 10-02 oven hotfix; 1.5.002 lands 2026-10-08 (cookie cap 120, Gnome Lab 130-2)
lede: Team power (전투력) gates stages and the Dimensional Rift: what raises it, what each source costs free and paid, posted gains, and the spend order.
caveat: Refreshed 2026-10-07, the day before the cap-120 update: level-120 gains are inferred or claimed, not posted. Few posted gains, all DCInside.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: At 2.2G your 35% reach is 304-19. Best posted lever: constellation-8 Stellar points (+10%), free to 8-3. From 10-08, levels 101–120.
changes: Stay in a guild with research: leaving cost one player ~23% of account total (13G → ~10G); team power not posted.
Keep a stage preset rolled for displayed power (crit resistance, SSR rune lines that add power); swap to it within a few % of a line (unmeasured).
Open and shape constellation-8 points up to 8-3: one step was worth +10% at 2G, about 304-19 → 308 at 35%.
Points past 8-3 need about 45 cookie stars from paid pulls.
Bank cookie EXP: from 10-08 levels go to 120 (+64% base stats, inferred; ~+25% power claimed at 119).
Put Gnome Lab stones into HP 30% and the lower ATK nodes before ATK 30% (~50M stones); the 2G → 4G player credits research most.
Plate the sword and bow toward 20 with Syrup for protection and restores; expect 2% per try at 19→20.
If spending on Stellar Points, use them to shape points that are open; don't chase 100% (95% is the practical end).

team_power.lede: Team power growth: every system that raises displayed team power, with its cost, cap, posted gains and the spending order by account stage.
team_power.caveat: Power is a gate for stages and the Rift, not a measure of strength: attack types and missing stats count more.

rules.title: Where team power counts
rules.body: Only stages and the Dimensional Rift compare team power with a recommended power (record 003's brackets). In Arena and Guild Conquest it decides nothing.

rules.title: Team power versus account total
rules.body: Team power (팀투, 덱투, 파티투력) is the lineup's figure the gate uses. Account total (총투) sums every cookie; crumb.gg's board shows it (top 500: 21.8G–50.8G, 2026-10-07).

rules.title: Arena excludes some sources
rules.body: Arena ignores Resolve, Stellar Link, the Gnome Lab, the guild lab and Fame. It counts level, promotion, pet holding effects, the collection, gear, plating and sugar runes.
